- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:12211,12247 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Two existing P5 intake tests (test_intake_cause_match_replay_posts_an_occurrence_with_no_new_reads, test_intake_cause_match_window_and_switch_off_byte_identity) assert `body.split("\n")[5] == f"<!-- {heal.MARKER_PREFIX}cause={cause} -->"`, but compose_issue_body now puts `workflow=` before `cause=`, so the cause line moves to index 6.
  WHY: CI job tests-heal-plan-and-validation fails in shards 2 and 3 with an AssertionError, which turns the aggregate lint gate red. Production code is unaffected (the validator at lines 727-736 accepts this order, and parse_heal_markers does not depend on order). This is the same root cause as the scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7778-7783 entry. Both reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7778-7783 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: compose_issue_body appends the new `workflow=` marker before the optional `cause=` marker, so for workflow_run-sourced issues the cause marker shifts from header index 5 to index 6.
  WHY: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:12211 and :12247 still pin cause at index 5 and fail in CI (tests-heal-plan-and-validation shards 2 and 3), blocking the PR. Proposed fixes: assert index 6 or use parse_heal_markers, or move the marker together with the validator at 727-736. All three reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:2539-2552 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new mock PATCH handler sets `issue['closed'] = True` on every `/issues/<n>` PATCH with a `state=` field, not only the heal stale-close PATCH. That includes the tracking-issue auto-close (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15583), the plan-split close (:15432) and the not_planned close (:23549).
  WHY: Shared fixture state now flips to closed partway through the tick (GraphQL line 2208, REST line 2571, filter line 2320, `result["tracking_closed"]` line 3994). The pre-push gate shows test_complete_verdict_falls_through_to_finalize_on_integration_drift (line 10898) failing and orchestrate-poll (2) red. Fix: gate the flip behind an opt-in store key such as `close_on_state_patch`. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19221-19231 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: _heal_stale_close_check fetches one page of runs (`per_page=${HEAL_STALE_GREEN_RUNS+10}`, capped at 100, no pagination), and heal_stale_decision (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py ~10190-10216) treats that page as the complete history since the anchor.
  WHY: A failed push run after the anchor that falls outside the returned page is never seen, so the issue can be closed as workflow_green while that failure exists (a quiet over-close). All three reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly treated this as accepted design, because the linked issue specifies a single `per_page=<HEAL_STALE_GREEN_RUNS+10>` read.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19103-19116 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The _heal_stale_close_check header comment says it "sends a Telegram INFO", but the success path at line 19287 calls `tg_notify_issue ... "DEBUG"`.
  WHY: This is documentation drift with no runtime failure. It misleads readers and invites re-raising a deviation that was already decided. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7761-7763 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The compose_issue_body docstring still says `cause` "adds the sixth header line", which is no longer true for run-sourced issues because the `workflow=` marker now comes first.
  WHY: Misleading documentation only (NIT).
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:(CI jobs failing: tests-heal-plan-and-validation, orchestrate-poll) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Multiple CI jobs fail on the current head. The pre-push test gate lists failures in tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py and others.
  WHY: These failures prevent the PR from being merged (BLOCKER). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 states that the jobs running these tests passed on head 5281a021 and do not map to this diff.
- (unmapped CI failures on the PR head):pre-push test gate on commit 5281a021 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The gate lists tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py and shellcheck as failures caused by this change. The failing test name in orchestrate-poll (2) is truncated, and none of these could be mapped statically to a hunk.
  WHY: The gate and CI are red on the head for reasons attributed to this change. The editor must reproduce each one and either fix it or record evidence that it is inherited (MAJOR).

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Log `HEAL_STALE_CLOSE issue=<n> outcome=closed|kept|skipped reason=<token> green_runs=<k>` and send a Telegram `INFO`."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, _heal_stale_close_check (success-path tg_notify_issue call at line 19287 and header comment around lines 19103-19116)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Evidence from all five reviewers:
    - The success path sends `"DEBUG"`, not `INFO`, because INFO is not a supported level. tg_helpers.sh `_tg_level_num` maps unknown levels to 0, and tests/test_alert_levels_human_only.py:123 forbids `INFO`.
    - The default Telegram threshold is WARNING, so DEBUG is suppressed and by default no close notification is delivered (luna, glm).
    - The agents.d fragment documents DEBUG, but the header comment still says "sends a Telegram INFO", so code, comment and fragment disagree.
    - The level deviation itself was accepted by the previous editor pass. The stale comment is the remaining fix.
- requirement: "Tests: `tests/test_heal_stale_close.py` (new), plus a poller fixture case."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_heal_stale_close.py
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The file was not created. The scenarios are covered instead in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py (heal_stale_* tests) and in the stale-close fixtures in tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py. The previous editor pass accepted this as a placement difference rather than missing coverage.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
